Cover material outcomes, effects and assumptions. A successful-completion relation gives no refusal/failure/interruption/unknown-effect claim. Actual execution conformance is separate; branches, concurrency and external effects need their applicable composition law.

State whether the assertion targets the full obligation or a narrower condition, and justify the implication relied on. A necessary-condition pass cannot establish the full obligation; a sufficient conjunction needs coverage and compatibility.

Equality is available for a justified declared target, including a narrower regression property. Keep its target and scope; establish the required relation to Q_r before a broader claim. Equality alone cannot reject permitted alternatives or prove the full obligation.

For every admitted case, a satisfied checker verdict implies the asserted predicate and a falsified verdict implies its negation, wherever those soundness directions are claimed. Retain unresolved support.

Universal soundness covers every admitted conclusion, not a favourable selected run. Actual checker and observation acquisition need conformance support; a selected model or ideal observation map does not supply it.

A reported pass or failure remains observation until oracle and observation justification support the claimed conclusion. Preserve original predicate, actual performance, uncertain effects and independently admissible counterevidence through the core.

A checker that always decides correctly from pi alone requires equal observations to imply equal predicate truth. A collision requires distinguishing evidence, justified narrower scope or indeterminate on that attempted decision.

obligations: Bind current A and its fallible acquired account, required Z and permitted transitions. Intent/Product/Specification refine Z under authority; lawful calculi do not choose Z or prove it satisfied. Refine into supported transitions where one adequate activation does not fit. Lawfulness alone establishes neither delivery nor optimality.

Distinguish required conditions, observations and causal/predictive models. Prediction accuracy proves no required outcome and prediction error alone proves no failure; a path may need discovery through bounded construction/evaluation.

Finite capacity motivates acquisition while purpose, identity, compatibility and assurance supply additional premises. Refinement may add detail and construction may change state within permitted variation. Decomposition, delegation, concurrency and recursive application preserve affected outer obligations and joins; local success establishes the outer outcome only with required coverage and preservation.

Strategy selects admissible construction/assurance within Z and the resource envelope. Account for material resources, feedback, uncertainty, integration and rework, including planning/checking/coordination costs. Measures state units/boundaries/composition; separate estimates, assumptions and observations. Owning criteria decide incomparable tradeoffs and the existing design/work record states rationale. Admitted work authority selects strategy; a superiority claim states objectives, comparison and assumptions.

Feedback diagnoses realization, requirement/design, predictive-model or observation defects, preserves unresolved alternatives and may first acquire evidence. Route supported repair to its owner, retaining counterexamples and unaffected work; changing the model proves neither repair nor the former Z.

Bugs use the same feature/change process. Labels supply no cause, repair class or grant; Spec binds lawful Product re-entry. Bug lists project existing work state; keep severity, priority, semantic result and authorized disposition distinct.

The selected control model truthfully handles its admitted states, including unavailable input, unknown conditions, failed preconditions, partial effects, exhausted capability/authority and revoked authority, through the core under its actual grant. Deterministic, probabilistic and human operations retain their selected outcome models.

Distinguish preservation, progress, termination and satisfaction. Induction/termination claims need premises/arguments; continuing work needs supported purpose. Discovery/counts/activity do not establish delivery. Completion requires current evidence/acceptance; changed Z, exhaustion and retry establish neither former completion nor impossibility. Repeat a failed relation only after supported causal change; reacquire changed support and uncertain effects before dependent action.

This section owns the shared construction relation; consumers apply it to delivery, correction and control while domain strategy, actor configuration, execution and additional assurance policy retain their owners.
permissions_exceptions: Applicable granted responses include continuation, repair, recovery, re-entry, refusal, yield or termination. A selected total control contract covers every admitted state, without requiring every operation to be total or guaranteeing a solution or external termination.
No universal termination proof is required to begin admitted bounded work; uncertainty reduction or testing a bounded hypothesis may justify continuation.

No exhaustive optimisation, scalar cost, numerical quota, preferred strategy, role sequence, independent ledger or orchestration runtime is imposed. Ongoing maintenance may continue under its mandate, while delivery needs a completion condition.

argument.conditional_consequence: Destination, observed reality, interpreted models, compatible joins and finite resources constrain supported strategy and feedback; lawful local activity cannot establish unsupported progress or completion.
policy_choices: Purpose authority selects Z; admitted work authority chooses strategy and response within assurance/resource policy; domain owners bind models, execution and additional controls.

source_family_arguments.premise_and_pillar_argument: F1 supplies required conditions; F2 distinguishes their meaning from prediction; F3 supplies observed reality; F5 bounds work; F6 bounds response. The instance supplies its outcome, fallible models and material resource/feedback tradeoffs. Specification, world modelling and outcome-driven development contribute comparison and correction on those distinct accounts.
source_family_arguments.conditional_consequence: A prediction error does not choose a repair or decide outcome satisfaction. Diagnose the supported discrepancy and choose useful authorised work within required assurance; a changed target cannot close the former one.
source_family_arguments.additional_policy_and_owner: The admitted work authority selects strategy; domain owners select causal models, measurements and additional risk policy. The requirement owner alone changes required conditions; a bug label supplies no authority.

source_family_arguments.conditional_consequence: A pass, formula or combined result supplies only the claim its justification establishes. The consumer binds the applicable assurance relations before dependent reliance.
source_family_arguments.additional_policy_and_owner: Domain policy selects required assurance and admissible evidence; the existing result algebra supplies conclusions. No additional stage, role or record follows.

source_family_arguments.conditional_consequence: Initial conditions, each step, compatible joins and the final implication are required for the end-to-end claim. Local validity, an invariant or a sequential argument establishes no unsupported arrival, concurrency or execution-conformance claim.
source_family_arguments.additional_policy_and_owner: The composite owner selects the properties and admissible loss; the execution binding supports conformance. Probability, induction or categorical claims require their separate mathematical premises and arguments.

source_family_arguments.premise_and_pillar_argument: F1 selects the source obligation; F2 binds interpretation and assertions; F3 binds observations; F6 limits conclusions to support. The instance supplies the case domain, observation map and checker relation. Information and evidence contribute the distinctions needed to judge the predicate.
source_family_arguments.conditional_consequence: A necessary-condition pass cannot establish a sufficient conclusion. Indistinguishable cases with different truth defeat a sound complete decision from that observation alone; favourable runs cannot establish universal checker soundness.
source_family_arguments.additional_policy_and_owner: The source owner fixes required meaning; the evaluation binding chooses its scope and instrumentation and supports actual conformance. A narrower scope needs justification; probability and computational feasibility require further models.

source_family_arguments.premise_and_pillar_argument: F1 supplies the obligations and consequence criteria; F2/F6 restrict conclusions to justified evidence; F5 makes assurance consume finite resources. Quantitative instances additionally assume a stated probability model with supported priors, likelihoods and dependence. Computation and evidence contribute measured cost and calibrated observations.
source_family_arguments.conditional_consequence: More checks and multiplying miss rates cannot substitute for applicability and dependence. A numerical posterior or detection probability remains bounded by the selected model and never implies whole-product correctness without that separate claim.
source_family_arguments.additional_policy_and_owner: Admitted work authority selects assurance within governing policy. The model supplies its probability assumptions; mathematical probability laws, not F1–F6 alone, justify the displayed identities. No universal threshold or mandatory quantification follows.

conditions.Binding: Identify actual subject/intended predicate, governing interpretation, applicable policy and source/current-state coordinates; names/equal bytes alone confer neither identity, standing nor applicability.
conditions.Support: Account for conditions and material dependencies that can change the determination. Inspect affected seams until governing obligations are covered or far-side independence is evidenced. Task boundaries, partial listings and no observed failure do not prove independence. Domain-owned completeness/sufficiency may not be silently narrowed.
conditions.Preservation: Establish material input/output/cross-boundary relations under declared compatibility or translation, applying Foundations Preservation obligations to the claimed step/composition. Retain identity, meaning, lifecycle, producer/evidence coordinates, constraints, authority and effects. Lawful differences require the admitted instance relation; neither universal equality nor invented translation decides compatibility.
conditions.Authority: Apply Foundations Judgment and authority to the actual operation/decision grant for this subject and effect. Bind required assessment through Independent assessment, retaining the domain additional conditions and authority requiring them.
conditions.Currentness: Acquire observations/concurrency/uncertain effects under Workspace and context, and apply Change impact and evidence retention to existing evidence. Supported changed dependencies reopen affected determination; unsupported currentness stays unresolved. Supported unchanged premises permit reuse without rechecking fixed graphs or every unchanged relation on every event.
conditions.Result: Apply core result/conjunction to actual predicates; retain failures, absent coverage, basis/scope diagnoses, original outcomes, performance and effects. Unknown applicability is not non-applicability; other uncertainty cannot erase supported failure.

obligations: Each consumer binds these conditions to its own decision and domain exceptions using existing dependency/authority evidence; do not create a second generic-rule owner. Exceptions must be named in owning policy; application cannot invent one.

Design admission binds its transition and complete enclosing relation; frame activation binds evaluation, subject, basis and actor. Both apply the six shared conditions while retaining different domain predicates. Reuse a supported condition through its validity route; a boundary crossing alone neither repeats proof nor permits omission of a changed dependency.

result_mapping.conditions: Evaluate the exact predicate using its owning domain conditions. Source labels/data do not choose a core verdict; preserve actual performance, effects, reasons and separately admissible failure. This inventory adds no domain refinement.

new_rows.predicate: An assessment meets the independence conditions required by its governing contract on the exact claim.
new_rows.applicability: Only where the governing contract requires independent assessment; the domain retains review boundaries, additional exposure/trace conditions and reserved decisions.
obligations: Bind whether independent assessment is required and its authorship, evidence, reference-exposure, actor and configuration conditions. Required nonauthor assessment excludes material authorship of the subject or repair. Self-review remains authoring evidence even after human acceptance.

A defect, counterexample or identification of already-required behavior does not itself author a repair and may be rechecked. Adopted material wording/policy/design is authorship: disclose it and do not independently assess that claim; retain unaffected judgment scope. Changed subjects/tests/conditions apply evidence-retention rules.

Shared sources/evidence are allowed only under required conditions. Actor identity, fresh context or model-family difference alone proves no independence. Keep statistical shared-cause assurance, frame disjointness, procedural independence and claim-relative nonauthor assurance distinct.
permissions_exceptions: No additional review boundary, reviewer count or model family follows; governing domains retain their particular requirements.
